description: This file contains the backend code for the 'TheoryExam' webpage in an online examination system. It manages loading questions, handling user navigation, and submitting answers to a SQL Server database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'TheoryExam.aspx' page, handling questions display, timer, navigation, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page by loading questions from the database, setting the timer, and handling session validation.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name based on the provided course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Submits the user's answers to the database, updates relevant queues and records, and navigates to the dashboard.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and checks for time expiration.
